findings.message: 7 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("Сохраняем характер.") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 415px of the width empty: section.dt-faq.dt-shell.
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.
